footnote: Source: Autonomy et al., UK pilot reports, Feb 2023 and Feb 2024, self-reported. University of Salford, Jul 2025. Images are AI-generated
notes: Why we are doing this. First, burnout: a year after the UK pilot, researchers went back to 28 organisations and 82% reported better staff wellbeing. Second, retention: half of them reported lower turnover, and at the end of the trial 15% of employees said no pay rise would get them back to a five-day week. Third, hiring: 32% reported easier recruitment, and South Cambridgeshire Council saw job applications rise by more than 120% after its switch. These figures are self-reported by organisations and staff, and the UK pilot was run with an advocacy group, so they show a direction, not a forecast for us. Revenue growth is not one of our reasons, and a later page explains why.
